module: gridSelector back-end descriptor shared by quickrace and lightRunner. Both draw their lists of levels and tracks from scenario_quickRaceLoader.getQuickraceList() and differ only by the back-end name (vehicle restrictions and start behavior are handled elsewhere). The result of build is meant for ui_oneshotRaceSelector_core.createBackend.
notes: level.name takes levelInfo.title: translation id for normal levels, raw text for the synthetic "Procedural Tracks" / "Track Editor Tracks" entries. _tr lets unknown ids through, so the call is systematic.
Track specifications display difficulty (via difficultyLabel), reversible, rolling start, laps, authors and length (in m).

build.desc: Returns the descriptor table (backendName, middlePathKey = "tracks", quickrace title keys, getLevels, getMiddleItems, middleName, display names, levelToTile, middleToTile, getLevelDetails, getMiddleDetails) for the named back-end.

backendName.desc: Back-end name; also serves as the base of the display options save file.
